relations: The performer's gripping hand shifts posture as the staff tilts between horizontal, diagonal, and near-vertical positions.
The staff's burning head sweeps broad arcs, expanding into a white-hot column during swings and shrinking at extremes.
A dark head with a blue-tinted wick leads the bright flame trail through the brightest part of the arc.
The swinging fire casts an orange glow on the performer's skin and sleeves while her torso remains fixed.
caption: The video captures a red-haired performer in a black costume with criss-cross strapped sleeves, positioned at the left against a twilight purple sky, bare branches, and a stone wall. She holds a long thin staff whose burning head sweeps through broad arcs, throwing a bright flame trail across the top and down the right side. The flame expands to a white-hot column during each swing and shrinks to a dim patch near the arc's extremes. A dark head with a blue-tinted wick leads the trail through the brightest part of the arc. As the staff swings, the rod tilts between horizontal, diagonal, and near-vertical positions while her gripping hand shifts posture. Her torso and face remain roughly fixed on the left while the fire casts an orange glow on her skin and sleeves. This arcing motion is already underway at the start and still continuing at the end.
